sloka: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य राममाता यशस्विनी ।पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृता कालधर्ममुपागमत् ।। ७.९९.१५ ॥
transliteration: atha dīrghasya kālasya rāmamātā yaśasvinī ।putrapautraiḥ parivṛtā kāladharmamupāgamat ।। 7.99.15 ॥

translations.english: After a long period, the illustrious Kausalya, Rama's mother, surrounded by her sons and grandsons, attained the law of time, meaning she passed away.
